s1.text: Vinyl bath toy on your cert? Check thirteen-oh-seven.

s2.text: Children's toys and child care articles can't be sold or imported with over point one percent of any of eight listed phthalates.

s3.text: That covers plasticized parts, like most soft vinyl.

s4.text: Say your bath toy's cert lists the toy standard, but not thirteen-oh-seven.

s5.text: Comment M and Z, we'll DM you the free CPSC finder.
